# Community code of conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Expectations

Be respectful, technical, constructive and considerate of other contributors. Assume good faith while still verifying claims. Avoid harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, unwanted contact, publishing private information, identity speculation or attempts to link synthetic faces to real people.

## Scope

This applies to project discussions, code reviews, issue threads and community interactions under the project's control.

## Reporting

Report concerns privately to **i.am@dangkhoa.dev**. The maintainer may edit, hide or remove harmful content and restrict participation when necessary. No response-time guarantee is offered.

The full dataset has separate privacy, provenance and release conditions; this code of conduct does not grant image rights.
